function: Channel estimation at the base station from 1 to 3-bit quantized received signals, pilots and learned quantization thresholds, uplink (pp. 3-4).
system: Multi-user uplink mmWave massive MIMO: BS with M=64 antennas, each with two low-resolution ADCs, K=32 single-antenna users, 28.9 GHz, no RIS (pp. 3, 6).
method: AQ-CGAN: conditional GAN with U-Net generator and patch CNN discriminator, random quantization thresholds as extra input, adversarial plus L1 loss; supervised, trained offline (pp. 4-7).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray tracing (Remcom InSite), indoor 10 m x 10 m room, 64 BS antennas, 32 users; 20,000 samples split 50/40/10% for train/test/validation (pp. 3, 6-7).
test_conditions: Same DeepMIMO scenario for training and testing (50/40/10 split); M=64, K=32 and pilot length 8 fixed; only SNR 0-25 dB and ADC bits 1-3 vary (p. 6).
baselines: Learned only: DNN, LAMP, GM-LAMP, CGAN with zero threshold (1-bit); GM-LAMP and CGAN (2- and 3-bit). No classical estimator in the NMSE figures (pp. 7-9).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (0-25 dB) for 1-, 2- and 3-bit ADCs; NMSE versus number of training iterations (convergence) (pp. 7-9).
complexity: Order of complexity O((MK+Mv+Kv)k^2 sum n_{l-1}n_l) for AQ-CGAN, with DNN, LAMP, GM-LAMP and CGAN orders in Table II (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 3: "We use the DeepMIMO framework to generate channel datasets between the BS and multiple users" (ray tracing from Remcom InSite, a widely shared ray-tracing dataset).
q2_support: p. 6: "All datasets are partitioned into training, testing, and validation sets in proportions of 50%, 40%, and 10%, respectively." Missing: no unseen scenario, antenna number, user number or pilot length is tested.
q3_support: p. 7: "including the LAMP algorithm, general DNN channel estimation algorithm, GM-LAMP algorithm, and CGAN algorithm" are all learned. Missing: no non-learned estimator is compared on NMSE (Figs. 5-7, pp. 8-9).
q4_support: p. 7: "The complexity of channel estimation based on AQ-CGAN comes from full connection network and convolutional network." Its order is given in Table II.
q5_support: p. 6: "First, the data for simulation is generated using DeepMIMO." Public DeepMIMO ray-tracing channels; the paper releases no code or link of its own.
notes: Included, area 2: learned CGAN channel estimator for mMIMO with low-resolution ADCs. q1 and q5 rest on DeepMIMO (scenario ID not named; 28.9 GHz stated on p. 6); the Gaussian entry assumption (p. 6) is used only to draw thresholds. q3 is 0 because LAMP and GM-LAMP are learned and AMP appears only in the complexity text (p. 7). Convergence curve (Fig. 4, p. 8) is not a performance comparison.
